name: Smew's Room
creator: Smew
description: Smew's Room is a Quest-friendly hangout world built by the creator Smew as a comfortable space to relax with friends. Alongside various interactive gadgets, it doubles as a personal museum of sorts, displaying photos from Smew's travels through VRChat. It is also known as the birthplace of Simp Wars, a fan-made Star Wars parody that started here.
